shellCommands.command: cat src/App.tsx src/main.tsx index.html tsconfig.json vite.config.ts; ls __agent_eval__; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui
ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components | tr '\n' ' '; echo; ls node_modules | grep -i -E "date|calendar|dayjs"; cat __agent_eval__/run.mjs | head -50

grep -ril calendar node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm --include=*.d.ts | head; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/lab; npm view @gravity-ui/date-components version peerDependencies 2>&1 | tail -8
npm install @gravity-ui/date-components @gravity-ui/date-utils 2>&1 | tail -8; git diff --stat package.json

git diff package.json; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/build/esm/components/Calendar; sed -n 1,80p node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/build/esm/components/Calendar/Calendar.d.ts; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/build/esm/components/Calendar/index.d.ts

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components && cat package.json | grep -E '"(main|module|types|exports)"' ; find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -name "Calendar*.d.ts" -print | head;

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/dist/esm/components/Calendar && cat Calendar.d.ts; ls; grep -n "locale\|lang" /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/ThemeProvider/ThemeProvider.d.ts | head

grep -rn "setSettings\|loadLocale\|updateLocale" node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/dist/esm --include=*.js -l | head; grep -rn "lang" node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/dist/esm/components/Calendar/Calendar.js node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/dist/esm/components/CalendarView/CalendarView.js | head; git status --short
